findings.meaning: The controller computes seven unrestricted requests, clips each change relative to robot_state.tau_J_d and passes the clipped vector to setCommand. The diagnostic publisher defaults to 30 Hz and reports the last cycle’s clipped vector plus model gravity alongside the current measured joint torque. An individual publication depends on the rate trigger and publisher lock. No unrestricted request appears in the message.

The scalar named root_mean_square_error sums abs(error_i)/7 across the seven joints. The name therefore describes a different statistic than the implemented mean absolute error. A retained bag can recompute both from tau_error.

On entry the residual between joint sensor readings and modeled gravity sets the initial offset. During updates those terms feed the PI calculation. Each axis of the torque request is then constrained to the previous desired value plus or minus 1.0 Nm per update. This software rate limit alone gives no observed hardware-rail events.

scope: No matching measurement file was identified by these particular code searches. The interface describes producers for this exact revision. It does not establish what another controller, log or firmware actually published.
